description: Start connecting Google Merchant Center for this workspace. Returns a short-lived, single-use SKULayer URL the workspace owner must open while signed in as the same person. That page sends them to Google consent and, when Google shows one account, links it. You never receive Google tokens. Optional feedId attaches that feed when there is exactly one account. If there are several, poll get_merchant_link and call select_merchant_account. Owner only. At most 5 starts per workspace per hour, on top of the normal MCP rate limit. Does not add a data source and does not write to Merchant Center.

feedId.description: Feed to attach when Google shows exactly one Merchant Center account. Omit to connect the account without attaching a feed yet.

name: start_merchant_link
title: Start Merchant Center link
